steps: A service instance registers its endpoint and health.
Registry publishes the current membership set.
Resolver watches or refreshes the versioned set.
Caller connects to a discovered healthy instance.

lesson.scenario: An inventory caller tracks rapidly changing pod endpoints without embedding addresses in application configuration.
